text:
Nina Rao: Quick note 10: we see a steady ~0.4% schema_error after enabling v3 in canary. Root cause: clients sending `context.env` as string. Need a safe compat plan.

Hector Morales: Can we accept both shapes temporarily?

Nina Rao: Proposal: accept both for 14 days, emit `compat.v3.context_string` metric, and return a Warning header with migration link.

Ivy Lin: Agree but avoid noise  sample full payloads at 0.5% and keep aggregated counters otherwise. Tag by tenant_id.

Samir Desai: For Dedicated/private installs, do not rewrite by default. Provide a per-tenant flag `compat_v3_context_rewrite`. Hosted defaults to rewrite-on for smoother UX.

Hector Morales: Add header `X-Redwood-Compat: v3-context-string` in responses so SDKs can detect. Also support incoming `Prefer-Compat: legacy-accept` for partner testing.

Ivy Lin: Edge cases: batched requests  normalize per-item and emit per-item metric. Streaming: include compat header at start of stream.

Nina Rao: Owners: infra/gateway for accept-both + headers (ETA 24h), runtime for rewrite+metrics (ETA 48h), console for tenant list + flag UI (ETA 72h).

ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: gateway/compat-accept -> eu-west-1. Monitoring hooks enabled.

Nina Rao: I'll draft runbook steps: detect window -> shim window -> enforce window. Also add alert: page if any tenant >0.5% for 24h and >5000 reqs.

Samir Desai: SDK snippet ready; will post in #eng-docs.

Nina Rao: Thankswe'll reconvene after 48h metrics. :thumbsup:
